import json,work
P=json.load(open('policy.json'))
cases=[
({'layers':[{'enabled':False},{'retries':0},{'label':''}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':False,'retries':0,'label':''},'error':None}),
({'layers':[{'retries':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':True,'retries':3,'label':'job_0'},'error':None}),
({'layers':[{'retries':None}]}, {'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':True,'retries':3,'label':'job_0'},'error':None}),
({'layers':[{'enabled':0},{'bogus':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),
({'layers':[{'retries':False}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
({'environment':{'enabled':'false','retries':'-0','label':''}},{'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':False,'retries':0,'label':''},'error':None}),
({'environment':{'retries':'+1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'environment':{'retries':' 1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'environment':{'retries':'1.0'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'environment':{'enabled':'False'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'environment':{'enabled':'bad','bogus':'x'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'})]
for i,(r,e) in enumerate(cases):
 a=work.evaluate(r,P)
 assert a==e,(i,a,e)
P2={**P,'null_resets':False}
a=work.evaluate({'layers':[{'label':None}]},P2); assert a=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'},a
P3={**P,'environment':False}
a=work.evaluate({'environment':{'bogus':'x','retries':'bad'}},P3); assert a=={'ok':True,'config':P['defaults'],'error':None},a
print('13 boundary checks passed')
